name: Cannon County, TN
findings: Cannon County has 42 nonprofit organizations. 7 of them (17%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 5 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (33% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Cannon County has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 7 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity in their tax returns or on their websites. Many may still offer them without describing them there.

confidence.text: Based on 7 organizations here; 48% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What do religious organizations here do in the community? How do people find out about them?

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in Cannon County list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 67% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 7 organizations here; 48% of all organizations here have no identified type.
